concerns.text: The OpenAPI spec returned at /api/v1/ai/docs in AiAgentDocsController contains minimal path metadata and does not include full request/response body schemas for /api/v1/ai/orders and /api/v1/ai/messages.
AiRateLimiterService uses an in-memory ConcurrentHashMap for rate limiting, which will not synchronize rate limits across multiple horizontally scaled application instances.

AuthorNotificationListener handles notification events using in-memory list buffering in AuthorNotificationService rather than integrating an external mail sender (e.g. JavaMailSender or SMTP/webhook service).
AgentSecurityAndE2ETest relies on SpringBootTest with MockMvc for E2E testing rather than spun-up HTTP client integration against a running server.
AgentInteractionTelemetryRepository @Modifying annotation was updated with flushAutomatically and clearAutomatically to prevent JPA persistence context stale reads during test execution.
